summary: Pure deletion PR with net-positive build and CI performance impact. No production code path affected; zero runtime regression risk.

build_time.note: Two crates removed from workspace.members on aarch64-apple-darwin. Kernel has 0 external deps (245 LOC); app depends only on kernel (420 LOC + binary link). Clean CI build saves roughly 2-5 s. Incremental local builds save near-zero (already cached).

ci_time.note: Lane was a BLOCKER-severity CI step with a 1200 ms runtime budget. Removing it eliminates: process spawn + cargo run recompile overhead + up to 1200 ms runtime = approximately 3-7 s per pipeline run.

runtime_production.note: No production code path. Crates were dev/CI-only fitness tools.

hot_path_impact.note: No hot path involved. Pure metadata/lane deletion.

complexity.note: Reduces workspace member count by 2, cargo dependency graph by 2 leaf packages, and registry catalog by 3 YAML entries. Lower graph complexity speeds future cargo metadata and workspace resolution operations (marginal but real).

limitations: Build-time estimate is based on LOC and dependency count heuristics; no measured wall-clock data available.
CI time delta is bounded by the documented 1200 ms runtime budget; actual run time may have been lower if the archive set was small.
Full workspace clean-build benchmark not run in this review; estimate is proportional to removed compilation units.
